verdict.rationale: Paddle documents and independently-probed evidence confirms a hosted, OAuth/API-key-gated MCP server (mcp.paddle.com) with a codemode search/execute interface letting agents perform billing operations via natural-language-driven tool calls, plus a docs MCP server, discoverable agent-skills index, and an LLM benchmark showing measurable pass-rate improvements from these integrations. This is strong first-party plus probe-verified evidence of natural-language/agentic operability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports (beyond vendor docs/probes) of successfully driving complex flows purely via natural language, and clarity on how non-destructive gating actually works in practice for safety in production use.
